125
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the August 24, 2005/Bhadrapada 2, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs;
Non-Conventional Energy Sources; Power; Rural
Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions —20
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
New Commission to look into Centre-
State relations
*401. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have proposed to set up a new Commission
to look into the Centre-State relations;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the draft terms of reference of the
Commission; and
(d) whether the States have been
consulted in the matter?
Creation of Telangana State
†*402. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) what special benefits are likely to
accrue  to the country if a separate
Telangana State is created;
(b) whether request has been made to
Government for the creation of Telangana
State; and
(c) what steps Government have been
taking in this regard?
Investments in domestic aviation
sector by PIOs and NRIs
*403. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRIMATI KAMLA
MANHAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Department of Industrial
Policy and Promotion (DIPP) have allowed
Persons of Indian Origin (PIOs) and Non-
Resident Indians (NRIs) to invest upto 100
per cent in domestic aviation sector;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have received
some representations for non-implementation
of above policy decision; and
(d) if so, the steps being taken to issue
directive to concerned Ministries/
Departments and State Governments
clarifying Government's stand on FDI by
PIOs in aviation sector under FEMA?
NTC mills in Andhra Pradesh
*404. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
SHRIMATI VANGA
GEETHA:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:

126
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(a) the number of National Textile
Corporation (NTC) Mills located in Andhra
Pradesh;
(b) the profits and losses of these mills
during the last three years; and
(c) whether any NTC mills have been
referred to BIFR during the last three years?
FDI in retail sector
*405. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
propose to carve out retailing into separate
categories and propose to allow FDI into
the sector;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have asked the
Consumer Affairs Department to prepare
a detailed note on organized retail sector;
and
(d) if so, the status thereof?
Pharmaceutical exports
*406. SHRI C. RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the total export of pharmaceuticals
to foreign countries during the last one year;
(b) the names of first ten pharma
companies who have achieved maximum
export orders of pharmaceuticals; and
(c) the steps Government propose to
take for companies in their plans to export
more pharma stock?
Eradication of rural poverty
*407. SHRI URKHAO GWRA
BRAHMA: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any long
term measures for total eradication of rural
poverty of the country;
(b) if so, the target year, if any;
(c) what is the actual figure of rural
poverty in India today;
(d) whether such figure is higher in STs
and SCs than other communities; and
(e) if so, Government's plan to tackle
the problem?
Sugar import from India by Pakistan
†*408. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
SHRI R.S. GAVAI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that recently
Pakistan Government has lifted the ban on
sugar import from India and now
Government are considering to export the
sugar;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when this export will start and
the quantity of sugar being considered to
be exported every year?
Exempting SEZs and EO units from
Labour Laws
*409. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Planning
Commission has recommended that Special
Economic Zones, Export-Oriented units
and large Special-Economic Zones should

127
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
be given exemption of complying with
provisions of some of the Labour Laws;
(b) if so, the details of provisions that
Planning Commission wish to exempt for
above zones;
(c) whether it is also a fact that Planning
Commission has recommended for
amending some of the labour laws on
priority; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Installation of wind farm in coastal
areas
*410. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of NON-
CONVENTIONAL ENERGY SOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government had made a
study on renewable and non-renewable
sources of energy to find possibilities of
installi

673
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the August 24, 2005/Bhadrapada 2, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Non-
Conventional Energy Sources; Power; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions —155
Assistance to shrimp farmers
by MPEDA
2969. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether MPEDA is considering a
proposal to set up branches at
Rajahmundry and Bhimavaram in Andhra
Pradesh;
(b) whether it is a fact that the hinterland
around Rajahmundry and Bhimavaram
supply huge quantities of shrimp for
export;
(c) what steps will be taken to assist
shrimp farmers with the latest scientific
knowledge by MPEDA;
(d) whether any such scheme is already
in place by MPEDA for these areas;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Guidelines to Patent gene
sequences
2970. SHRIMATI  N.P. DURGA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are working to prepare guidelines to Patent
gene sequences;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) in what manner this move would
help India in preventing others from using
some biological material for commercial
purposes?
SEZs planned for Maharashtra
2971. SHRI VASANT CHAVAN:
SHRI SANJAY RAUT:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
SHRI DATTA MEGHE:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the number and details of the Special
Economic Zones planned and approved for
being set up in Maharashtra;
(b) the Central aid sanctioned therefor;
and
(c) the progress so far made in this
regard?

674
Economic cooperation with EU
2972. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the European
Union (EU) proposes to upgrade economic
cooperation with India at par with
China;
(b) whether the EU has asked India that
it should try to remove the bureaucratic
hurdles coming in the way of foreign
investment in our country; and
(c) if so, what is the action plan of
Government to remove red tap in
bureaucracy to attract large investment from
EU countries?
Formulation of strategies for
promoting Indian goods
2973. DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has
constituted five working groups and three
special study groups to formulate strategies
for promoting Indian goods and services in
specific sectors;
(b) if so, whether these panels would
submit their recommendations to the
recently reconstituted Board of Trade;
and
(c) what will be the main objects of
these panels and to what extent it will be
helpful for improving the exports?
Opening of separate office of
Explosive Department
2974. SHRI LEKHRAJ BACHANI:
PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
a proposal from the Government of Gujarat
for opening of a separate office of the
Explosive Department at Alang Ship
Recycling Yards in Gujarat; and
(b) if so, the present status in this
regard?
Export  of banana to Gulf
countries
†2975. SHRIMATI  KUM KUM
RAI: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have explored
possibilities of export of Indian banana to
Gulf countries;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Export of diamonds
†2976. SHRIMATI  KUM KUM
RAI: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the names of countries to which
diamonds are exported from India;
(b) whether it is a fact that the export of
diamond has decreased during the last few
years;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the measures being taken by
Government in this regard?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

675
Economic agreement with Gulf
countries
2977. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Associated Chamber of Commerce and
Industry of India (ASSOCHAM) had
demanded of the Government to implement
a framework agreement of economic
cooperation between India and the Member
States of Gulf;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether it is also a fact that in the
absence of such agreement, Indian exporters
have to move their export proceeds to
these countries at much higher import
duties?
Site offered by Andhra Pradesh
Government for holding ITPO
exhibition
2978. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Government of Andhra Pradesh has offered
site for the establishment of an exhibition
site by ITPO in Hyderabad;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether ITPO has any plans to
select a site in the State to organize trade
fairs on a regular basis;
(d) if so, the details of the
